description: Round-15 applies the useful parts of UAV/VisDrone small-object detection practice to the aircraft defect dataset: preserve small-object pixels, keep the validated N2 augmentation policy, and prioritize label quality before more architecture changes.

metadata_defaults.notes: Inspired by VisDrone/UAV small-object work, but constrained by prior local evidence: no sliced inference only, no new P2/attention branch, no copy-paste by default.

experiments.name: R15_C1_CleanV3_N2
experiments.title: N2 recipe on targeted manual-clean v3 labels

metadata.notes: Highest-priority candidate. Keeps the current best N2 recipe and applies the round14 finding that label consistency is the main bottleneck.

experiments.name: R15_C2_FitWithinV2_N2
experiments.title: N2 recipe on fit-within detail-preserving dataset

metadata.notes: Tests the UAV small-object lesson that preserving effective object pixels can matter more than heavier model changes.

experiments.name: R15_C3_MRdupX2_N2
experiments.title: N2 recipe with conservative missing-rivet rebalance

metadata.notes: Low-risk class-balance candidate for the smallest and weakest class. Uses existing curated data instead of synthetic copy-paste.

experiments.name: R15_C4_N2FinetuneLowLR
experiments.title: Low-LR continuation from the N2 anchor

metadata.notes: Starts from the strongest N2 checkpoint and continues with a small AdamW learning rate to test whether the baseline can be nudged above the existing 0.352565 anchor.
